# refoRest

## Overview

`refoRest` provides tools to detect, analyze and visualize disturbances in remote sensing index time series.

The package implements a complete workflow including:
- z-score based disturbance detection
- spatial patch delineation
- map creation using `ggplot2`
- automatic generation of outputs (maps, tables and report)

It is designed to make disturbance analysis reproducible and easy to apply to local raster time series data.
